messages:
Dan: Heads up — I'm proposing a tf module change for gpupool: switch the az_weights input from a map(string -> number) to a list(number) so we can express ordered AZ affinity. This is a type change and will show up as replacements in a plain plan. Need migration/shim discussion.

Mira: Can you paste a minimal diff or example of the new shape?

Dan: ```hcl
# OLD: variable "az_weights" { type = map(number) }
# NEW: variable "az_weights" { type = list(number) }
# we expect input like [0.2, 0.5, 0.3] instead of {"us-west-2a" = 20, ...}
```

Alex: Why not add a compatibility layer and keep both inputs for one release? e.g. az_weights_map + az_weights_list then normalize in locals. That avoids immediate replaces in gitops.

Jen: +1. We broke a prod pool last quarter doing a straight type swap. Keep a compat var, mark old one deprecated.

Dan: Did a quick staging plan. Without a shim TF shows a -/+ on the aws_autoscaling_group resource (replace). Sample plan snippet: 
```
-/+ module.gpupool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpus (forces replacement)
  # ... will recreate instances
```
Replacement would restart instances and cause capacity churn.

Sam: Can infra-bot queue a canary apply in the us-west-2 staging gpupool (gpupool-staging-1)? We should test the shim behaviour end-to-end.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: queued job #4521 — terraform plan (staging) started by Dan.

Mira: Also watch KMS input types. Last migration we had module.kms accept an object in some repos and a string in others which caused unexpected diffs. Add normalization there too: local.kms_alias = try(var.kms.alias, var.kms)

Alex: For migration steps include explicit `terraform state mv` guidance if resource addresses change, and a small state-mutation script for customers that can't do rolling replaces.

Dan: Proposed rollout plan:
1) Add compat variables and locals to normalize both shapes.
2) Add deprecation warnings in README and module output.
3) Cut v2.3.0 with shim.
4) Run staged canary apply (2 pools) and watch for any replace churn.
5) After 1 week of stable, cut v3.0.0 that removes the compat layer.

Jen: Timeline?

Dan: PR by EOD Friday, canary next Monday, wider rollout mid-next-week if no issues.

Mira: I'll run the canary and monitor capacity & any unexpected AZ rebalancing. If plan still shows replacement we abort the apply.

Sam: Pinging @oncall for capacity window and to avoid surprises during the canary.

Jen: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: plan completed for job #4521. No destructive replaces detected in canary due to compat shim present.

Dan: Great — I'll open the PR with the shim + README migration steps (including example `terraform state mv` commands and the short script to convert map -> list for older states). Will link the canary plan output.

Mira: Thanks. I'll follow up with monitoring playbook changes to check for unexpected instance churn and KMS errors.

Alex: When you open the PR, add a small note for ops: how to validate after apply (fz: check ASG desired==running, check node labels, check KMS CMK key policy errors).

Dan: Will do. Thanks everyone.
